page_title: JUV 1-0 INT | Juventus v Inter 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' Marcus Thuram (Inter) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar.
90+2' Juventus take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+2' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top of the net. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Yann Sommer produces an easy save. Juventus force a corner. They send men into the box.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Nicolo Barella (Inter) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
88' The foul by Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) was seen by Maurizio Mariani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
88' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
87' A snap shot from distance by Nicola Zalewski (Inter) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
86' Marcus Thuram (Inter) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range.
85' The linesman raises his flag. Federico Gatti (Juventus) is adjudged offside.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is coming onto the pitch as Francisco Conceicao cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' Substitution. Hakan Calhanoglu is replaced by Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
80' It is time for a substitution. Joaquin Correa (Inter) is on for Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
77' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Khephren Thuram will be replaced by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus).
77' What a great touch by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
74' 1 - 0 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani provides Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
72' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
69' Marcus Thuram (Inter) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Maurizio Mariani who sees an offensive foul.
66' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
66' Rough tackle by Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlos Augusto replacing Mehdi Taremi (Inter).
62' That will be all from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marcus Thuram.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicola Zalewski comes onto the pitch so that Federico Dimarco (Inter) can be given a rest.
59' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Nicolo Savona is replaced by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
58' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
57' Federico Gatti (Juventus) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
56' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
56' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) trips an opposition player and Maurizio Mariani signals a foul.
52' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
51' Weston McKennie (Juventus) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.

50' Excellent touch by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.

48' Renato Veiga (Juventus) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Yann Sommer, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
48' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
48' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus). Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Referee Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45' Federico Dimarco (Inter) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Michele Di Gregorio. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Inter.
43' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the right post.
43' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) commits a foul and Maurizio Mariani immediately signals a free kick.
42' That's unlucky! Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
40' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
39' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
37' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
35' Denzel Dumfries plays a pass to Lautaro Martinez (Inter), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball goes high over the bar.
34' A pass from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is intercepted by Michele Di Gregorio and the move breaks down.
33' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

33' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) latched on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his strike isn't accurate at all and the ball goes way wide of the left post.
29' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
29' Federico Dimarco (Inter) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
29' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
27' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
25' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Maurizio Mariani had a clear view and blows his whistle.
24' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
23' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
23' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

22' A sweet pass finds Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Yann Sommer is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Juventus will take a corner kick.
22' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the bottom left corner from distance, but Yann Sommer hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
19' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.

19' What an opportunity! Mehdi Taremi (Inter) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the left side of the goal, but Michele Di Gregorio reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
14' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
12' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nicolo Barella (Inter) heads on.
12' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
10' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
9' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
8' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared by the defence.
8' The ball is cleared after Denzel Dumfries (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Inter.
6' Nicolo Barella (Inter) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
5' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
4' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
3' What a big chance! Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and misses the net well wide of the right post.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Inter will take the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will referee today's match.
